component.description:
What it does Reads from or writes to a SQL database as a step in a flow. It can use a database the platform provisioned for your organization, or one you already run elsewhere: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite or BigQuery.

How it works Two modes. In platform mode the statement runs through the platform against a database it manages for your organization, and your database privileges are checked; a query needs the query privilege and a write the write privilege. In external mode it connects out to your own database with a connection string bound as a secret, so the host needs an outbound route. Build the statement from the Inspector fields - pick the operation, name the table and columns, add a WHERE - or write the exact SQL yourself. ${field} placeholders take their values from the incoming data and are always inserted as quoted literals, never as raw SQL; a placeholder whose field is missing stops the run rather than becoming NULL. Results come back as rows, capped by Max Rows, with truncated set when there were more. A bad setting stops the run before anything is sent. In platform mode a missing privilege or a stopped database is returned as a result with success false so the flow can branch; any other failure stops the run. Neither the SQL nor any row is written to the logs.

Configure Connection
- Connection Mode - platform (default) or external.
- Database ID - which provisioned database, in platform mode.
- Database Type - postgresql (default), mssql, sqlite or bigquery, in external mode.
- Database Connection String - bound as a secret, external mode only: postgresql://user:password@host:5432/db, mssql://user:password@host:1433/db (the certificate is verified; add ?TrustServerCertificate=yes only for a self-signed one), sqlite:///path/to/existing.db, or a BigQuery service-account JSON key.
Statement
- Operation - SELECT (default), INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or CUSTOM.
- Schema Name (public, ignored on SQL Server and SQLite), Table Name, Columns (* by default).
- WHERE Clause - for SELECT, UPDATE and DELETE. GROUP BY and ORDER BY - for SELECT.
- Insert Columns and Insert Values - for INSERT. SET Clause - for UPDATE.
- Custom SQL - the full statement when Operation is CUSTOM; everything above is ignored. A statement starting with SELECT or WITH reads; anything else is sent as a write.
- Max Rows - result cap, 100 by default, at most 10000.
- Response Field Name - put the rows under this key, merged into the incoming data.

In and out In: any data; its fields fill the ${field} placeholders. Out: success, operation, rows (one object per row), row_count, columns and truncated; a write returns affected_rows and a message instead of rows. With Response Field Name set, the incoming data plus the rows under that key. A refusal returns success false with error and error_type.

Use it when
- A flow needs to look up reference data before deciding what to do.
- You want to record the outcome of a run in a table.
- An existing reporting database has to feed a model or a decision step.
component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: agent
name: Database Connector
description: >
  Execute one SQL statement (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or custom)
  against a platform-provisioned PostgreSQL database or an external
  PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite or BigQuery database. Platform queries run
  through the platform; external credentials come only from the
  connection_string secret bound on the orchestration node. A bad setting
  raises before anything is sent; a platform refusal (403, 409) is a result
  with success false; any other failure fails the run.

input_ports:
  - port_name: input
    port_type: in
    artifact_type_input: none
    artifact_type_output: json
    # The response_field_name path spreads the inbound request_data into the
    # result (`{**request_data, response_field: rows}`).
    response_data_passthrough: request_data
    # That same path writes the rows under a key named by response_field_name,
    # so one key is chosen at configuration time.
    response_data_contract: dynamic
    response_data_contract_reason: >
      When the `response_field_name` parameter is set the result rows are
      returned under that configured key (`{**request_data, response_field:
      rows}`), so the key set is fixed only once the node is configured.
    response_data:
      affected_rows: integer (optional) - Rows changed; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE only.
      columns: array - Column names returned by the query.
      error: string (optional) - Failure description; error results only.
      error_type: string (optional) - Refusal class (PermissionError, ServiceUnavailable).
      message: string (optional) - Human-readable write summary; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE only.
      operation: string - Operation that ran (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CUSTOM).
      row_count: integer - Rows returned by the query.
      rows: array - Result rows as column-keyed dicts; empty for write operations.
      success: boolean - Whether the query completed.
      truncated: boolean - Whether the result set hit the max_rows ceiling.

required_secrets:
  - name: connection_string
    label: Database Connection String
    required: false
    description: >-
      External mode only. postgresql: postgresql://user:password@host:5432/db;
      mssql: mssql://user:password@host:1433/db (add ?TrustServerCertificate=yes
      only for a self-signed certificate); sqlite: sqlite:///path/to/file.db;
      bigquery: a service-account JSON key.

input_parameters:
  - name: connection_mode
    type: select
    label: Connection Mode
    options: [platform, external]
    default: platform
    required: true
  - name: platform_database_id
    type: text
    label: Database ID
    description: UUID of the platform-provisioned database to query.
    depends_on:
      parameter: connection_mode
      visible_when: [platform]
  - name: db_type
    type: select
    label: Database Type
    options: [postgresql, mssql, sqlite, bigquery]
    default: postgresql
    required: true
    depends_on:
      parameter: connection_mode
      visible_when: [external]
  - name: operation
    type: select
    label: Operation
    options: [SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CUSTOM]
    default: SELECT
    required: true
  - name: schema_name
    type: text
    label: Schema Name
    default: public
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE]
  - name: table_name
    type: text
    label: Table Name
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE]
  - name: columns
    type: text
    label: Columns
    default: "*"
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SELECT]
  - name: where_clause
    type: text
    label: WHERE Clause
    description: Supports ${field} placeholders resolved from request_data as quoted literals; a missing field is an error.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE]
  - name: group_by
    type: text
    label: GROUP BY
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SELECT]
  - name: order_by
    type: text
    label: ORDER BY
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SELECT]
  - name: max_rows
    type: integer
    label: Max Rows
    default: 100
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SELECT]
  - name: insert_columns
    type: text
    label: Insert Columns
    description: Comma-separated column list for INSERT.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [INSERT]
  - name: insert_values
    type: text
    label: Insert Values
    description: Comma-separated values for INSERT. Supports ${field} placeholders.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [INSERT]
  - name: set_clause
    type: text
    label: SET Clause
    description: e.g. status = ${new_status}. Supports ${field} placeholders.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [UPDATE]
  - name: custom_query
    type: text_long
    label: Custom SQL
    description: Raw SQL. Supports ${field} placeholders resolved from request_data.
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [CUSTOM]
  - name: response_field_name
    type: text
    label: Response Field Name
    description: 'Wrap result rows under this key (e.g. "users" produces {users: [...]}).'
    depends_on:
      parameter: operation
      visible_when: [SELECT, CUSTOM]
component.name: DATABASE CONNECTOR (SYSTEM, READ-ONLY)

columns.description: Column names returned by the query.

operation.description: Operation that ran (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CUSTOM).

rows.description: Result rows as column-keyed dicts; empty for write operations.

truncated.description: Whether the result set hit the max_rows ceiling.

component.short_description: Runs one SQL statement against a platform-provisioned database or your own PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite or BigQuery.
